records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Partners
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Cedar Partners* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Project created day 2 shows real initial engagement, but no invite sent and no reply to either outreach (email:5b58cc56, email:1a348e95) in 6 days; no tickets, Starter solo user. 8 days remain, so self-serve activation is possible but silence suggests drift.

draft.subject: Next step for your Cedar Partners workspace
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the right starting point.

The usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add several at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through what your team should tackle first and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Nadia
